final: WITH filtered_standings AS (SELECT driverId, points, wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points >= 1.0), driver_averages AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) as avg_points, AVG(wins) as avg_wins FROM filtered_standings GROUP BY driverId), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_mean_wins FROM driver_averages), with_diff AS (SELECT da.driverId, da.avg_points, da.avg_wins, da.avg_wins - om.overall_mean_wins as difference FROM driver_averages da CROSS JOIN overall_mean om) SELECT driverId, avg_points, avg_wins, difference FROM with_diff ORDER BY CASE WHEN difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference DESC LIMIT 10
